description: How character speech is presented. Consumed by both scene_lua (in-scene dialog) and the standalone NPC dialog tool.
prompt_template:
Given these prior picks:
  menu_style: {prior_picks.menu_style}
  character_style: {prior_picks.character_style}

Generate {count} dialog style options covering:
- Text speed: instant | fast (1ch/frame) | normal (1ch/2 frames) | slow (1ch/4 frames) | variable
- Portrait position: bottom_left | bottom_right | top_left | top_right | none
- Portrait kind: static | 2_frame_talk_loop | expression_set
- Box style: full_width_bottom | half_width | nine_slice_panel | no_box (overlay)
- Choice display: vertical_list | horizontal_list | radial_wheel | gridview
- Advance input: A | crank | A_or_crank | auto_after_delay
- Font: system | custom_pixel | custom_serif | custom_handwritten
- uses_blip_synth: true plays a playdate.sound.synth note per character

Return a JSON array of exactly {count} options matching option_schema.
refinement_prompt: Revise the dialog option below per the user feedback. Keep uses_nine_slice consistent with box_style.

option_schema.name: string
option_schema.text_speed: enum: instant | fast | normal | slow | variable
option_schema.portrait_position: enum: bottom_left | bottom_right | top_left | top_right | none
option_schema.font: string (system | custom_pixel | custom_serif | custom_handwritten or custom font name)
